sentences.ar: صرخوا كتير وما حدا رد عليهم.
sentences.en: They shouted a lot and nobody answered them.
The candles were running out little by little.
Becky wept and sat on the ground.

sentences.ar: توم قال لها: أنا معك، ما تخافي.
sentences.en: Tom said to her: I am with you, do not be afraid.

sentences.ar: نامت على كتفه وهو ضل صاحي.
sentences.en: She slept on his shoulder and he stayed awake.
He was counting the hours in the dark.
